title: JGates ASVS decisions of a project (.jgates/asvs.json)
description: The project's own ASVS decisions: the version they are for, the chosen level (level 1 while the file does not say otherwise) and the requirements, sections or chapters recorded as not applicable, each with a reason and the date it was recorded. Applicability does not expire, so there is no end date. JGates writes it one entry at a time, with a preview and an undo, and never in governed mode; other keys a person adds are kept.
